cards.title: Hit mark: sharp
cards.text: The white star is gone. A blade or arrow landing (the Dame's sword here). Three takes.
cards.why: You called the star "weird" and said it hid the shots' own bursts. Each type of hit now has its own sign, kept off the attacker.

items.label: 1 Gashes
items.text: Two short slanted gashes on its edge, raw pink cores, two slivers out the sides.

items.label: 2 Edge
items.text: The struck side of its outline lights up, a thin cut across it.

items.label: 3 Spray
items.text: No shape on the body: fine slivers fly out of both sides.

cards.title: Hit mark: blunt
cards.text: A mace, hammer, club or stone landing (the Paladin's mace here). Three takes.
cards.why: Blunt blows should read as a thump, not a cut. All three keep clear of the one swinging.

items.label: 1 Pow lines
items.text: Comic impact lines out both sides of where it landed, a dust puff past each.

items.label: 2 Dent
items.text: A fat crescent on its edge squashes in; two ripples run off it.

items.label: 3 Grit
items.text: Chunky grit knocked out to the sides, a small puff of dust.

cards.title: Hit mark: magic
cards.text: Spells by element: fire, frost, poison, holy, curse, nature, water, plain. Three takes.
cards.why: A spell's hit wears its element's colour and bits, so you can tell what landed without a white star on top.

items.label: 1 Pop
items.text: A quick glow and its element's bits (flames, ice chips, bubbles, glints) thrown out the sides.

items.label: 2 Edge
items.text: The struck side of its outline lights up in the element, bits spilling off the ends.

items.label: 3 Spray
items.text: A fan of the element's bits sprayed out of both sides.

cards.title: The struck body
cards.text: How the body itself shows the blow (with hit mark 1). Now: a pale white wash.
cards.why: You said white puffs hid the hero. Two of these keep the picture fully clear.

items.label: 1 Rim
items.text: No wash: a bright rim round its outline for a blink, in the blow's colour.

items.label: 2 Tint
items.text: A short, light wash in the blow's colour (steel, cream, or the element).

items.label: 3 Jolt
items.text: A harder shove and a shake, with a quick red flinch.

cards.title: Critical hits
cards.text: Every blow here is a crit. Now: only a gold number (not drawn) and a tiny freeze.
cards.why: Crits had nothing to show for them in the arena. Gold is kept for crits only.

items.label: 1 Burst
items.text: A gold comic burst pops beside the struck edge, speed lines past it.

items.label: 2 Rays
items.text: Thick gold rays shoot out from all round the body's edge.

items.label: 3 Shards
items.text: Gold shards fly out the sides and a thin gold ring snaps out.

cards.title: Blocks on a shield
cards.text: Foes swinging at the Paladin's raised shield. Now: a white star and a pale arc.
cards.why: A blow on a shield should look turned away, not landed. Pale gold is the shield colour.

items.label: 1 Clang
items.text: The shield's face rings bright along its curve; sparks fly back off it.

items.label: 2 Ward
items.text: A shield of light pops on its face and rings out twice.

items.label: 3 Deflect
items.text: The blow glances off at an angle; dust kicks up behind his feet.

cards.title: Misses and dodges
cards.text: A foe dodging most blows. Now: nothing shows (the word "dodge" isn't drawn).
cards.why: A dodge was invisible: the blow just did nothing. No words: a shape.

items.label: 1 Swoosh
items.text: The blow's sweep carries on past the body, clear of its edge.

items.label: 2 Sidestep
items.text: Speed lines on the side it slipped from, dust kicked from its feet.

items.label: 3 Air
items.text: An empty pale puff and two curls where the blow fell on nothing.

cards.title: Small explosions
cards.text: Two small blasts among four skeletons (one with burn). Now: white flash, ring, flames.
cards.why: Explosions in the game's own flat style; each is quick so bodies show again fast.

items.label: 1 Cloud
items.text: Inked puffs roll out to the edge, a quick core, smoke rising after.

items.label: 2 Burst
items.text: A layered cartoon starburst blooms and folds in; chunks fly past it.

items.label: 3 Shock
items.text: A shock ring runs along the floor, sparks to the edge, flame boils up.

cards.title: Big explosions
cards.text: One big fire blast over four skeletons.
cards.why: The same three at full size, to see which still reads when it covers a crowd.

items.label: 1 Cloud
items.text: Inked puffs roll out to the edge, a quick core, smoke rising after.

items.label: 2 Burst
items.text: A layered cartoon starburst blooms and folds in; chunks fly past it.

items.label: 3 Shock
items.text: A shock ring runs along the floor, sparks to the edge, flame boils up.

cards.title: Elemental explosions
cards.text: Frost, poison, holy and curse blasts in turn.
cards.why: Each element brings its own colour and bits (ice chips, bubbles, glints, wisps).

items.label: 1 Cloud
items.text: Puffs in the element's colours with its bits among them.

items.label: 2 Burst
items.text: A starburst in the element's four colours, its bits flung out.

items.label: 3 Shock
items.text: The floor ring in its colour, sparks out, its bits rising.

cards.title: Heals landing
cards.text: A big heal, a heal over time, another big heal. The green crosses stay.
cards.why: Heals showed only small crosses; a big heal now feels big, a trickle stays quiet.

items.label: 1 Lift
items.text: Soft green light climbs up through the body; crosses pop at its edge.

items.label: 2 Swirl
items.text: Green motes wind up round the body and wink out over its head.

items.label: 3 Glow
items.text: The body takes a green wash and one big cross pops over its head.

cards.title: Buffs landing
cards.text: Rage, War Song, haste, a ward in turn. Now: nothing marks the moment.
cards.why: A buff landing had no moment of its own. Each in its own colour, no rings round heroes.

items.label: 1 Chevrons
items.text: Three chevrons in the buff's colour rise beside it.

items.label: 2 Glints
items.text: Four glints drop in onto its edge and it flashes the colour.

items.label: 3 Spiral
items.text: A ribbon of the buff's light winds up round it once.

cards.title: Deaths: bone
cards.text: Skeletons falling. Now: a white pop, a ring, puffs and white stars.
cards.why: Each family breaks apart its own way, in its own colours, no white puff over the body.

items.label: 1 Bits
items.text: Bones and a skull flung the way it was knocked, tumbling.

items.label: 2 Poof
items.text: A puff of bone dust and a few bones.

items.label: 3 Soul
items.text: A pale wisp rises off it; a few chips fly.

cards.title: Deaths: slime
cards.text: Slimes bursting (ice and plain).
cards.why: A slime leaves no body, so it splats: goo on the floor a moment.

items.label: 1 Bits
items.text: Goo blobs flung out, a splat on the floor.

items.label: 2 Poof
items.text: A splash of goo-coloured puffs.

items.label: 3 Soul
items.text: Bubbles rise and pop; a splat on the floor.

cards.title: Deaths: beast
cards.text: A wolf and a boar falling.
cards.why: Fur and dust, in the animal's coat colour.

items.label: 1 Bits
items.text: Tufts of fur flung the way it was knocked.

items.label: 2 Poof
items.text: A dust cloud in its coat colour, a few tufts.

items.label: 3 Soul
items.text: A pale wisp rises off it, a few tufts.

cards.title: Deaths: construct
cards.text: Machines breaking (an automaton, a cog sprite).
cards.why: Machines come apart: cogs, plates, soot and sparks.

items.label: 1 Bits
items.text: Cogs and bolted plates flung out, soot on the floor.

items.label: 2 Poof
items.text: A puff of grey smoke and a few parts.

items.label: 3 Soul
items.text: Steam rising, a cog sprung loose, sparks.

cards.title: Deaths: spirit
cards.text: A ghost and a wisp fading out.
cards.why: Spirits have no body to break: they come undone into light.

items.label: 1 Bits
items.text: Wisps of it fly up and out.

items.label: 2 Poof
items.text: A puff of its own mist.

items.label: 3 Soul
items.text: The spirit spirals up and away.

cards.title: Coin pickups
cards.text: Coins scattered and pulled in. Now: a small sparkle.
cards.why: You asked for the coins to home in; the moment they land should show.

items.label: 1 Flip
items.text: The coin pops up spinning and winks out.

items.label: 2 Hop
items.text: The coin hops over the hero's head into its pocket.

items.label: 3 Ring
items.text: A thin gold ring and four glints.

cards.title: XP from kills
cards.text: Two kills near the party. Now: nothing shows xp coming in.
cards.why: XP in the bar's violet, so it reads as the bar filling.

items.label: 1 Motes
items.text: Violet motes curve from the kill into each hero.

items.label: 2 Orb
items.text: One orb rises off the kill and splits to each hero.

items.label: 3 Rise
items.text: Motes drift straight up off the kill towards the bar.

cards.title: Level-ups
cards.text: The Dame then the Archer levelling up. Now: only the sound.
cards.why: A level-up is a big moment and had no picture in the arena.

items.label: 1 Pillar
items.text: A column of gold light rises out of the hero, chevrons climbing it.

items.label: 2 Burst
items.text: Gold rays shoot out, then confetti flutters down.

items.label: 3 Crest
items.text: A gold up-arrow pops over the head, glints round it.
